name: Dark ambient (1980s industrial-adjacent menacing drone)
lineage: 1980s and 1990s ambient subgenre developed through industrial-music adjacent scene, characterized by drone-and-texture-based composition emphasizing menacing, dark, foreboding atmospheric content. Lustmord (Brian Williams), Coil, Nurse With Wound, and the broader Cold Spring Records and Side Effects label rosters anchor the canonical sound. Distinguished from broader ambient by dark ambient's explicit horror-cinematic-and-occult thematic orientation.
